steps.content: It's that dream again.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: I'm sorry... Lavina, I didn't bring her back...

steps.speaker: Dying Girl
steps.content: I'm sorry, Mom. I escaped, I didn't get killed by Nirvana...

steps.speaker: Dying Girl
steps.content: I'm back, Mom. You too can...
[Screen flashes as she snaps out of the dream]
She jolts awake and immediately breathes a sigh of relief. She has this dream often, and every time she snaps out of it like this. She's used to it already.
But today seems a bit different.

It's clamorous outside. Lavina isn't sure what's happening. She instinctively checks on Hella next to her. Once she confirms that Hella is alright, she throws on her clothes and heads out, bumping into a running Greta.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Ahhhh!

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Greta, it's me! What's going on?

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Lavina? Run, it's the Executive Committee. No, perhaps their higher-ups, some unknown people have broken into the base! Matilda... She's...

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Crache left and hasn't come back.
A chill runs through Lavina, but she quickly steadies herself and checks the surveillance screen.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You're... Executive Officer Matilda Cavendish.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The records show that you were kidnapped this week. How do you explain this?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I was indeed kidnapped. I heard from my captor that the ${PlayerName} is around here.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: So I came to verify the information. After confirming that they were all innocent refugees and not harboring any rebels, I decided to carry on with my census and resettlement tasks assigned by the Executive Committee.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I've done my job well and gained everyone's trust. I've helped them stock up on relocation supplies. You may ask the refugees.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That doesn't concern me. Is ${PlayerName} here?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I regret to tell you that he's not here and has never been. I think this is incorrect information, or simply a decoy.
steps.female_content: I regret to tell you that she's not here and has never been. I think this is incorrect information, or simply a decoy.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your judgment is not required. That's the job of the Paradeisian troops. Lead the way, we're going to inspect the infirmary.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Are they heading this way? These are all fellow Rustfire members, and many are on the list. What should we do? What should we do?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Calm down! Matilda will buy us some time. Now, let's hurry up and move the injured and these documents.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: These people's intentions are unclear, but just in case.
She has a very bad feeling about this.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Lead the way, we're going to inspect the infirmary.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I wouldn't recommend you barge in like this. West District has been isolated for too long, a forceful approach will only stir up panic and distrust.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Since you came here on behalf of Paradeisos, please seek dialogue in a more appropriate manner.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Such formalities are not important. Lead the way, Matilda Cavendish.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your background check is complete. Do your current actions represent the Cavendish family? Are you going to obstruct an important operation of Paradeisos on behalf of your family?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: It's a shame, but I can't represent my family. I am a laughable disgrace to the Cavendish family.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: The only person I can represent is myself...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Terminating conversation. Proceeding with independent action. Area scan complete. Location of the injured confirmed.
It wants to bypass Matilda and keep advancing, but is stopped by a barrel pointed to it.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I am Matilda Cavendish, Executive Officer of the West District Reconstruction Committee. My job is to facilitate the reconstruction of West District, open up conversations, bridge the gap, and explore a new future.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: If you insist on hurting them, as an adjutant, I must promptly rectify the error of my superior.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: I will stand against you until the communication is reestablished.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Judging Matilda Cavendish to be a hostile target. HUSH, remove the obstacle. Now.
Several grotesque humanoids charge over with evident hostility. The refugees let out terrified cries, jostling and fleeing.
Matilda pulls the safety lever, aiming while secretly making calculations.
The Guardian has gone out to receive a new batch of refugees. How long can I hold on before she comes back?
At that moment, the blue-haired gladiator bursts onto the battlefield, her eyes shining with excitement.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Forces from Paradeisos? That's a good one, leave it to me!
